featureCases.expected: A Balance past its deadline without a claim is forfeited: the Allocation is cancelled, the Balance void, the Application Forfeited, the Deposit kept by the rule "Balance not paid" (a 0 % rule records no refund; a 10 % rule one refund, never two) and the student told; a claim waiting keeps the Bed, and so does a later Balance deadline a Manager chose when approving a late check-in, which may not pass the arrival day (the Balance is paid before check-in).

unitTests.requirement: Places Approved Applications on free Beds by hard constraints, priority and fit; flags conflicts; deterministic

cases.what: an invited pair shares an empty 2-bed Room; the next student gets NO_BED when none is left.
a student who is no longer eligible is flagged and never placed.
an invited partner who is not in the run blocks the pair (PARTNER_NOT_READY).
a single student joins the Room whose occupant shares the most attributes.
the priority group goes first; the same input gives the same proposal.
a placement with few shared attributes is kept and marked LOW_FIT (information only).

unitTests.requirement: Splits a Room's Utility between residents by the days each lived there; rounding

cases.what: residents who lived in the Room the whole month pay equal shares.
a check-out cuts the meter; the leaver's share is marked settled (paid from the Utility Deposit).
within a segment, shares follow the time each resident lived in the Room; totals round up.
without a reading at the end there is nothing to share yet.

unitTests.requirement: Exchanges the web's Google authorization code for an ID token; maps Google's errors

cases.what: the code is posted with the popup redirect URI and the ID token is returned.
a used or expired code is the user's retryable error (401).
a wrong client secret is our misconfiguration, not the user's (503).
Google cannot be reached (503).
without a client secret the code flow is off and Google is never called.
a code of the redirect flow (popup blocked) is exchanged with the sign-in page as redirect URI.

unitTests.requirement: Sends push messages through FCM HTTP v1 with a service-account JWT; reports dead tokens

cases.what: a signed service-account JWT buys an access token; the message goes to the device.
an unregistered device token is reported so it can be disabled; other errors are failures.
the JWT is RS256-signed with the service account key and names the FCM scope.

unitTests.requirement: Translates API messages to Vietnamese from the catalogue, with values

cases.what: exact texts and texts with values are translated, a value from the catalog too; English stays English.
a text without a translation, an unknown language and null are returned unchanged.

unitTests.requirement: Chooses the email transport and the demo mailbox redirect of fictional accounts

cases.what: with a demo mailbox an email to a fictional account goes there, the recipient in the subject and a header.
without it the email goes to its recipient unchanged; without SMTP nothing is sent or thrown.
a real account receives its own email even while a demo mailbox is set (spec O-3).

unitTests.requirement: Admits only the configured web origins (CORS)

cases.what: an exact origin and a Vercel preview pattern are both admitted.
other origins are refused, and a blank setting keeps CORS closed.
